(def bit-count

rationale: Explicit fixed defn bootstrap adaptation retains the original algorithm, metadata and docstring. Original Suss (#443): the count is one popcount of the value's int32, as the pin's shifts, masks and multiply compute it, without boxing their 32-bit masks. Original Suss: a return-only long hint exposes the existing guaranteed int32 result to primitive callers, without narrowing the boxed operands or changing ToInt32 conversion.
